Title: Community support for Node 14 LTS is ending on 30 April 2023

Body.Content:
On 30 April 2023, extended support for Node 14 LTS will end. After that date, your applications that are hosted on App Service will continue to run and your existing workloads will not be impacted. However, we'll no longer provide patches or customer service for Node 14 LTS.

Required action 

To avoid any service disruption and potential security vulnerabilities, follow the steps to update your applications to Node 16 LTS before 30 April 2023. 

Help and support 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a  support request:.
